description: This file defines the jjwg_Address_Cache class, which extends the jjwg_Address_Cache_sugar class. It manages address cache data, including retrieving, saving, and deleting address records, and includes configuration and validation methods.

classes.name: jjwg_Address_Cache
classes.description: A class responsible for managing address cache data, including retrieval, storage, configuration, validation, and deletion of address records in the cache database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and optionally loads configuration settings.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings and initializes the jjwg_Maps bean.

methods.name: getAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Retrieves address cache data for a given address, returning info if valid cache exists.

methods.name: saveAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Persists new address cache info into the database, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: deleteAllAddressCache
methods.description: Deletes all address cache records in the database tables.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if a longitude value is within valid range (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if a latitude value is within valid range (-90 to 90).
